title: Vibronic quantum dynamics of ultralong-range high-$\ell$ Rydberg molecules
summary: We investigate the non-adiabatic quantum dynamics of ultralong-range Rydberg molecules using a vibronically coupled two-channel treatment. The two-channels are composed of coupled trilobite and butterfly electronic states, formed as a result of $S$-wave and $P$-wave scattering of high angular momentum Rydberg electrons with perturbing ground state atoms. Within the Born-Oppenheimer treatment, the $P$-wave scattering channel introduces an adiabatic decay pathway that affects the stability and lifetimes of trilobite states.
